resume_controls.before_each_completed_resume: Read only the permitted exported RESULT.json financial/operating fields from that newly created account, save safe values/digests before invoking _execute; do not open account databases, keys or credential material.

requirements: Use the same original output and its frozen source; never call run again over an existing output.
Require independent native re-audit after resumed execution and then the explicit verify command.
Generate final pair comparisons only after completed resumes and verifies.
Raw RESULT/SUMMARY byte digests may change only through documented regenerated telemetry/receipt metadata; do not use a stale pre-resume result digest as final evidence.
Any financial/native-action/event change is a failed resume control and must be retained and reported.

Download actual public release assets into a new scoped location, validate GitHub asset digests and release verify acceptance, and bind tag/commit/tree/source ZIP/manifest to the expected identities above.

stopping_and_failure_rules: Execute every fixed case and arm to its existing 42-day horizon and drain its registered queue; preserve every positive, negative and zero outcome.
No source/economic-input/seed/cohort/acceptance-threshold changes, replacement worlds, tuning or optional early stopping based on observed profit.

The existing run wrapper has a 180-second subprocess deadline; this is preserved as an existing per-command platform boundary, not a new experimental budget. Record any timeout/interruption and retain its authentic account/source/queue.

Recover an interrupted account only with its same frozen source and original output under the existing _execute interface; any extra recovery command is separately counted and retained, without reseeding or deleting failure receipts.

A native audit, source/input validation or resume-control failure remains a failed check; stop the dependent unsafe action and report it. Other independent fixed worlds may finish without changing their preregistered definitions.
If all four complete, run all explicit verifies and both final comparisons regardless of economic sign; no sales, investment, or positive status is forced.
